newsitem.title: CANADA: Magellan to buy Bristol Aero for C$62.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Magellan to buy Bristol Aero for C$62.5 mln.

text.p: Toronto-based Magellan Aerospace Corporation said on Thursday it agreed to buy Rolls-Royce Industries Canada Ltd unit Bristol Aerospace Ltd for C$62.5 million.
The C$62.5 million purchase was expected to be completed in July 1997. Rolls-Royce had previously announced it was divesting of its investment in the Bristol facilities to focus on its core business.
Bristol has more than 900 employees in Winnipeg and Rockwood, Manitoba, and Medicine Hat, Alberta. It maintains and repairs aircraft.

Magellan said in a separate statement that it had an underwriting agreement with a syndicate managed by Newcrest Capital Inc for the issuance of 11 million common shares at a price of C$5.00 each for total gross proceeds of C$55 million, on a bought deal basis.
The issue is being made by way of a short-form prospectus to be filed in all provinces of Canada and is expected to close on or about July 14, 1997.
The closing of this issue is conditional on the closing of the acquisition of Bristol. The issue is subject to regulatory approval.
